# descope_turnstile_connector (Resource)

Manages a Turnstile connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Prevent bot attacks on your login pages with the Turnstile connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The secret key authorizes communication between Descope backend and the Turnstile server to verify the user's response.
- `site_key` (String) The site key is used to invoke Turnstile service on your site or mobile application.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
